core_border.rule: Core owns semantic identity and explicit borders; autonomous islands own native execution/reasoning/domain semantics.
must_not_claim: Common Lisp implementation/library semantics merely because callable
package/domain algorithms merely because implemented in Lisp

d10_bridge_meanings.behavior: invoke one semantic identity on an autonomous execution island using opaque native payload while preserving producer-native observation and provenance
represent one admissible execution mechanism witness for a semantic identity without granting semantic authority or changing identity
represent an opaque producer-native observation without universal truth or result coercion
observe the result cardinality of one completed native observation without coercing the native results
perform an explicit partial conversion from a source native result representation toward a target representation while preserving source observation and making no semantic-equivalence assumption
represent typed absence of an execution capability such as kernel or bridge without changing semantic identity or registry numbering

package_reclassification.rule: Reclassified rows leave Core, not the ecosystem; their provenance and package/island ownership remain preserved.

zones.CORE-DONOR: May donate universal Core language law after exact duplicate/ownership review.
zones.PACKAGE-ISLAND: Owns application/domain semantics; only separately factored universal border laws may enter Core.
zones.SUBSTRATE-ISLAND: Owns compiler/runtime/target/backend mechanism; only universal seam laws may enter Core.
zones.REFERENCE-WATERS: Comparison/reference evidence only; no semantic ownership.
